youtube_full.title: The Nest Among the Stars | Bedtime Scripture Story for Kids | Obadiah 1:3–4
youtube_full.description:
The Nest Among the Stars: a bedtime scripture story for kids from Obadiah 1:3–4.

Obadiah told what Heavenly Father said about the people of Edom. They were unkind to their own family, the people of Israel.

Tonight's Scripture Traveler: Wren the Wonderer.

Read along as the pages turn, then answer the bedtime questions together.

0:00 Opening the book
0:11 The story: The Nest Among the Stars
1:12 Scripture Traveler of the Night: Wren the Wonderer
1:48 A Feeling Moment and the Five Stones
2:58 Question time
3:15 Sweet dreams
3:33 More stories, the app and the paperback
